name: 31984-longdecode-gptoss20b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder, mxfp4 expert weights, 24 layers, 32 experts with 4 active per token; the checkpoint's own config.json is the authority and the engine prints it at startup.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 64 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 31984.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn: 500 prompt tokens and 6400 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0, no shared prefix, no multimodal. `ignore_eos` and a hard `max_tokens` are set, so 6400 tokens are generated rather than capped; the rendered prompt tokenizes to 567 on the wire, so a request occupies 6967 tokens at its longest.
purpose: A long-form report writer generating 6400-token drafts from short prompts for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: openai/gpt-oss-20b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 16
max-model-len: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
